Name: Rose Iridium Tools for Alternative Textures and Fashion Sense
Author: zaoux
Description:
I was scrolling through this website a day or so ago, looking for a tool retexture mod, when I came across [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55973382]LooneyLuny's [/url]gorgeous mod called
'[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23982]Rose Iridium Tools and Weapons[/url]'.
I downloaded it and she was glorious. The only problem I had was...
My modded tools were [i]so [b]ugly[/b].[/i]
So I fixed it!

The Paint Bucket and the Scissors are direct sprites from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55973382]LooneyLuny[/url], the Paintbrushes and Spray Cans are recoloured in the palette, and the Mirror was handmade with this colour palette!

This is just a sprite replacement, so it'll just override the sprites in the original mods!

Credit for pretty much all of the assets goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55973382]LooneyLuny[/url]﻿!


[b]- How to use - [/b]
1. Unzip in your mods folder.
2. Drag files into folder.
3. Accept replacement of files.
4. Enjoy your lovely, pastel floral goodness.
